usages.explain: Usage: First discussing a mild situation, then stating that the situation extends to even more severe circumstances.

examples.content: 木村さんは英語が話せる。そればかりか中国語もフランス語も話せる。
examples.transcription: きむらさんはえいごがはなせる。そればかりかちゅうごくごもふらんすごもはなせる。
examples.mean: Mr. Kimura can speak English. Not only that, but he can also speak Chinese and French.

examples.content: 田中さんはその男に着る物を与えた。そればかりか、いくらかの金まで持たせてやった。
examples.transcription: たなかさんはそのおとこにきるものをあたえた。そればかりか、いくらかのきんまでもたせてやった
examples.mean: Mr. Tanaka gave the man something to wear. Not only that, but I also gave him some money.

usages.synopsis: そればかりか: has the meaning of expressing comparison, judgment "not only that, not only that"

title: そればかりか => Not only that, it's not just that
